# OBSIDIAN (01 · obsidian)

Haute horlogerie under raymarched liquid gold — an SDF metaball shader with studio lighting.

- **Technique:** RAYMARCH GLSL
- **Tags:** luxury, dark, gold, premium, minimal, 3d, shader, watch, jewelry
- **Best for:** luxury goods; watches & jewelry; premium product launches
- **Fonts:** Cormorant Garamond, Inter
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;1,300;1,400&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #0a0a0c · #c9a24b · #f0d089
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/obsidian/` (Template.astro, content.ts, interactions.ts, liquidGold.ts, meta.ts, style.css, theme.css, watch.ts)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* obsidian — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --ink: #0a0a0c;
  --ink2: #101014;
  --ink3: #17171c;
  --ink4: #0d0d11;
  --gold: #c9a24b;
  --gold-hi: #f0d089;
  --gold-lo: #8a6a28;
  --gold-mid: #e7c268;
  --gold-deep: #6b5220;
  --bone: #e9e4d8;
  --bone-dim: #9b968b;
  --bone-faint: #5d5a52;
  --scroll-thumb: #2a2a30;

  /* hero fallback gradient (visible while WebGL is unavailable) */
  --hero-glow: #3a2c10;
  --hero-mid: #14100a;

  /* raymarch shader colors, quantised from the original GLSL vec3 constants */
  --gl-gold: #c79438;
  --gl-spec: #ffd980;
  --gl-rim: #ffe699;
  --gl-bg-far: #131210;
  --gl-bg-near: #070709;
  --gl-bloom: #0d0903;

  /* watch dials */
  --dial-edge: #050506;
  --dial-obsidian-face: #0b0b0e;
  --dial-obsidian-face2: #1a1a20;
  --dial-obsidian-idx: var(--gold);
  --dial-obsidian-hand: var(--bone);
  --dial-obsidian-sec: var(--gold);
  --dial-meteor-face: #2c2c31;
  --dial-meteor-face2: #45454c;
  --dial-meteor-idx: var(--bone);
  --dial-meteor-hand: var(--bone);
  --dial-meteor-sec: var(--gold);
  --dial-forest-face: #0d1f16;
  --dial-forest-face2: #1c3a2a;
  --dial-forest-idx: var(--gold);
  --dial-forest-hand: var(--bone);
  --dial-forest-sec: #e06a4a;

  --serif: "Cormorant Garamond", serif;
  --sans: "Inter", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `interactions.ts`
  - `initTilt(cards: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Cards lean toward the pointer in 3D and settle back on leave.
  - `initMagnetic(buttons: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Buttons drift toward the pointer while hovered.
  - `initClockText(el: HTMLElement)` — Keep `el` showing the visitor's local time (h:mm).
- `liquidGold.ts`
  - `initLiquidGold(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Raymarched liquid-gold metaballs (SDF + smooth-min) filling `canvas`. Shader colors come from the `--gl-*` tokens. Hides the canvas when WebGL is unavailable.
- `watch.ts`
  - `buildWatch({ size, dial, brand, place, uid, live }: WatchOptions)` — Build an SVG watch face; hands are live (rAF) or posed at 10:08.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<a>/<span> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Dial finishes the watch renderer knows; each maps to `--dial-<id>-*` tokens in theme.css. */
export type DialId = 'obsidian' | 'meteor' | 'forest';

export interface CraftItem {
  /** Small italic index, e.g. "01 — Movement". */
  num: string;
  title: string;
  /** When true, the live local time (e.g. "10:08 AM") is appended to the title. */
  clock?: boolean;
  text: string;
}

export interface Watch {
  /** Dial finish. */
  dial: DialId;
  name: string;
  /** Reference line under the name. */
  ref: string;
  price: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Brand wordmark in the nav and footer; the <em> is tinted gold. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  /** Section anchors available: #craft, #collection, #manifesto, #atelier. Nav is hidden below 900px. */
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** Wrap the shimmering gold word in `<span class="gold">`. */
    headingHtml: string;
    body: string;
    cta: Link;
    /** Label of the animated scroll cue at the bottom. */
    scrollLabel: string;
  };
  /** Items of the scrolling ticker; the middle dot separators are added automatically. */
  marquee: string[];
  craft: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Four items: the first two render left of the live watch, the rest right. */
    items: CraftItem[];
  };
  /** Text printed on every watch dial. */
  dial: { brand: string; place: string };
  collection: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Label revealed on card hover. */
    enquireLabel: string;
    watches: Watch[];
  };
  manifesto: { quoteHtml: string; cite: string };
  specs: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    rows: { label: string; valueHtml: string }[];
  };
  footer: {
    addressHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered only when the Template receives `showcase`. */
  showcase?: { chipLabel: string; chipHref: string; footerHtml: string };
}
```
